title: Launch risk sprint-backlog and SLA guardrail sheet
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet is a compact sprint-backlog focused on launch failure modes, KPI guardrails and automated rollback criteria. Intended for product-ops + SRE + Release Eng during the 3-week ramp to canary and 1-week full rollout. Treat as canonical short-form checklist during the launch window; longer playbooks live in Confluence (linked).

Scope & assumptions:
- Applies to hosted API and Dedicated initial traffic ramp only (Private deployments handled by customer runbooks).
- Canary cohort: 2% of production traffic, 00:00–06:00 PT, progressive 2x/day increments based on green signals.
- Primary metrics observed: latency_p95, latency_p50, error_rate_5m, cost_per_1k_tokens, model_regression_score (eval sentinel), daily_active_routes.

Sprint backlog (ranked by impact):
1) Critical: Canary auto-fallback mapping (owner: Priya) — ensure route -> fallback_model table is populated for top 10 routes. Tickets: JIRA-PRODOPS-842. Status: in progress.
2) High: Cost budget enforcement (owner: Diego) — implement daily budget alert (>$X/day predicted). Linked PR: infra#1184. Status: review.
3) High: Regression sentinel set (owner: Ava) — 120 prompt set for each canary route, baseline run and delta rules (+/- 3% accept). Status: ready.
4) Medium: Load-shedding policy draft (owner: Marcus) — priority-based 503 for non-essential routes. Status: draft.
5) Medium: Operator dashboard widgets (owner: Jordan) — single-pane view: p95, errors, qps, cost burn rate. Status: blocked on metrics tag changes.
6) Low: Postmortem template pre-filled (owner: Priya) — include token-level cost delta section. Status: ready.

KPI guardrails (hard thresholds used for automated decisions):
- latency_p95 (global): must remain <= 320ms over 10m window. Breach -> circuit opens, route degraded to fallback model.
- error_rate_5m: must remain < 1.0% for critical routes. Breach -> pause traffic increase, trigger SRE pager.
- model_regression_score: delta <= +3% (higher means worse). Breach -> automated rollback to last-green model version.
- cost_per_1k_tokens (projected 24h): not to exceed budget by >15%. Breach -> hold rollout to next increment.
- tail-latency spikes: if outliers cause >10% of requests >1s for 5m, initiate graceful degradation (serve cached or smaller model).

Leading indicators to watch (manual signals):
- Increased variance between p50 and p95 (>3x) within a route.
- QPS drop >20% on a downstream system (db, auth).
- Unusual pattern in logits distribution (suggests model misbehavior).

Rollbacks and automated actions matrix:
- model_regression_score breach -> auto-rollback to previous stable model tag (automated). Pager to on-call engineer and product-ops notified.
- latency_p95 breach (sustained 10m) -> switch traffic to lower-capacity quantized variant or cached responses for affected endpoints.
- sustained cost burn anomaly (algorithmic billing drift >15% predicted) -> throttle non-essential routes and notify finance + product.
- repeated 5xx spike (>3x baseline) -> pause rollout and run healthcheck-suite v1.2 (healthcheck runbook link in artifacts).

Go/No-go checklist for each roll increment (to be ticked by on-call + release lead):
[ ] Dashboard green for p95, p50, errors, and cost projection
[ ] Canary sentinel pass (regression suite)
[ ] Fallback mapping verified for top 10 routes
[ ] Ops on-call and SRE readout done (Slack #prodops + #sre on-call)
[ ] Communications: incident channel created and paging policy reviewed

Escalation paths (contacts):
- 1st: SRE on-call (pager) — support for infra failures
- 2nd: Release Eng lead (Marcus Li) — rollout control & infra fixes
- 3rd: Product Ops (Jordan Kim) — stakeholder comms and gating decisions
- 4th: Eng Director — for cross-org interventions
(Confluence contact matrix link in linked artifacts)

Operational runbook snippets (copy-paste friendly):
- To force-rollback model: infra-cli rollback --route <route> --to-tag <last-green> --reason "regression-sentinel-breach"
- To set fallback mapping: infra-cli fallback set --route <route> --model <model-id>
- To throttle route: infra-cli throttle set --route <route> --qps 0.5 --duration 30m

Unresolved questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- How quickly can observability ingest model_regression_score? target < 60s end-to-end — action: instrument eval pipeline. (Assigned to Ava)
- Confirm cost alert thresholds with finance for Q1 credits. (Assigned to Diego)
- Validate fallback model quality by running 2k synthetic queries. (Assigned to Priya)

Release cadence and timing notes:
- Week -1: final regression baseline + DR rehearsal (no traffic).
- Day 0: canary 2% -> monitor 24h, increment only if all green signals sustained for two 6h windows.
- Day 1-3: ramp to 10% with repeated checks every 6h.
- Day 4-7: full rollout dependent on steady-state KPIs and business signoff.

Post-launch immediate actions (first 72h):
- Daily standup with SRE + release lead + product-ops (15m)
- Compile token-cost delta report and attach to the release ticket
- Triage any missed sentinel prompts and mark for hotfix if regression severity >= moderate

Appendix: quick reference KPIs and thresholds
- p95 latency: <= 320ms (10m window)
- p50 latency: no specific target but should track < 150ms ideally
- error_rate_5m: < 1.0% (critical), < 2.5% (non-critical)
- model_regression_score delta: <= +3%
- cost_per_1k_tokens: alert if predicted > budget * 1.15
- canary cohort size: 2% initial -> doubling increments (max 50% by day 3 if green)

Notes: Save any ad-hoc findings into the linked Confluence playbook and reference JIRA-PRODOPS-842 for retrospective actions. This sheet intentionally keeps items brief — expand in Confluence when converting to a final runbook.

Last update summary (2026-02-20):
- Added automated rollback CLI snippet and cost projection guard.
- Regression sentinel prompt set finalized (120 prompts) and uploaded to artifact store.
- Small outstanding blocker: metrics tag change required for single-pane dashboard (blocking Jordan).
